narrative.overview:
Butwal Hacks is a flat, layered SaaS platform built for Nepal's hacker community — a workbench with everything a builder needs and nothing they don't. The design prioritizes clarity, hierarchy, and earned familiarity over ornament.

Surfaces are solid white or light gray (#F7F7F8 / #FFFFFF). Borders are crisp 1px (#E5E5E5). Depth comes from tonal layering — lighter content areas, slightly darker sidebars and panels — not from shadows or blur. A single assertive red accent (#FE0000) earns its place by being used sparingly on primary actions and verified credentials only.
keyCharacteristics: Layered-by-default — depth through background lightness changes, not shadows or glass
Single accent discipline — Butwal Red is the only accent; appears on ≤10% of any screen
Selective glow — red glow appears only on primary CTA hover and verified trust markers
Mono confidence — JetBrains Mono for badges, metadata, IDs signals 'this is technical, precise'
Responsive grid — repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)) for adaptive layouts

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Butwal Red is the only accent. Status colors carry meaning (green = success, blue = info), not decoration. If a color can't justify its role in one sentence, it's decorative — remove it.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: Any text that represents a technical identifier (BH-ID, date, task name, API key) uses JetBrains Mono. Any text meant to be read as prose uses DM Sans. If in doubt, DM Sans wins.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat until the user interacts with it. Shadows and glows are responses to hover, focus, or active states only. At rest, the interface is a set of crisp planes distinguished by lightness alone.

dos: Use bg-surface / border-border / rounded-xl as the standard card recipe
Use bh-btn-pill (rounded-full) for primary CTAs — the red glow appears on hover
Reserve Butwal Red (#FE0000) exclusively for CTAs, trust markers, and verified badges
Use JetBrains Mono uppercase for all badges, labels, timestamps, BH-IDs, and metadata
Use focus-visible:ring-2 ring-primary-red ring-offset-2 as the global focus indicator
Layer depth through tonal background changes (lighter content, darker sidebars)
Use text-body for body copy (#333333 light / #cccccc dark)
Use text-muted for placeholders, timestamps, and secondary metadata
donts: Use backdrop-blur — no glass effects on any surface
Use inline style={{}} for colors — use var(--bh-*) CSS properties or Tailwind classes
Use more than one accent on a screen — Butwal Red is the single accent
Use box shadows on cards at rest — shadows are hover-interaction feedback only
Use DM Sans for badges, IDs, or metadata — JetBrains Mono is for technical precision
Use gradient text, parallax effects, or animated cursor-tracking elements
Use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards
Use the hero-metric template (big number, small label, gradient accent)
Recreate the Kloner.app look exactly — the hybrid approach is the brand
